translations.web: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
translations.bsb: Which of you can prove Me guilty of sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe Me?
translations.kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
translations.asv: Which of you convicteth me of sin? If I say truth, why do ye not believe me?
